page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4g.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

A key characteristic of this instance is its integrated local storage, which consists of 3839 GB of SSD capacity. This bundled storage is complemented by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators.

From a resource density perspective, the combination of dedicated Intel Xeon processing cores, a balanced 1:4 memory-to-vCPU ratio, and substantial local SSD storage provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring high-throughput local I/O without the overhead of external storage attachments. This hardware profile is suited for database hosting, storage-intensive applications, and general-purpose enterprise workloads that benefit from high-speed local storage and dedicated compute resources.
